name: ripple-button
title: Ripple Button
description: A dark outlined button that answers each press with a circle growing out of the spot the pointer hit. The pale disc swells to twice its size and fades away.
use: A press needs clear visual confirmation without shifting the layout, especially on touch screens.
avoid: Buttons that already animate their state, or tiny buttons where the disc has no room to read.
a11y: Keyboard activation drops the ripple at the top-left corner since there are no pointer coordinates; reduced motion is ignored. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One rounded rectangle on black, drawn with a thin grey border, a near-black fill and bold white text. On a press a pale blue-grey disc appears beneath the label, widening past the button's inside edges before it thins.
behaves: Every click drops a circle centred on the pointer; over about six hundred milliseconds it scales from nothing to double size while fading to transparent, then disappears. Between presses the button does not move.
customise: The label is children and a click handler can be passed through; ripple colour and duration are props, while border, padding and type come from className and the base classes.
weight: light: One absolutely positioned span per press with a single keyframe, removed after it runs.
issues: The ripple is clipped inside the button, so it reads as a wash of fill rather than a wave leaving the edge.
polishWhy: A competent, standard material-style ripple, but the plain bordered button adds little.
